notes: All intervals are previously seen history; no new blind-test claim or replacement of the sealed candidate after evaluation.
Primary IC stays signed H5 for every method; H20 IC and H20 excess-return R2 are secondary, explicitly named diagnostics.
All learned methods keep 30/40/30 group weights. Classic value-quality is a separately labelled 50/50 fundamental/price baseline, never silently substituted into the fusion.
Economic per-share valuation factors are snapshot/share-basis proxies, not certified PIT or split-adjusted fundamentals.
Every fold uses full six-month signed validation and conservative H20 label-exit purging. Only matched_control uses V7 reliability gating.
Calibrate H20 excess-return magnitude using up to twelve months of strictly earlier out-of-fold forecasts with matured H20 exits; no arbitrary maximum slope or direction flip.
The slow allocator uses H20 covariance and expected excess return without a trailing-market-mean forecast; excess-return forecasts are not absolute-return guarantees.
Cash return zero, no leverage/shorting; single-name cap applies to new net-edge allocations. 20bp per side primary cost remains fixed.
